summary: BRBI BR Partners S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice to the Market disclosing board approval of a R$30,000,000 capital contribution to subsidiary BR Partners Participações Financeiras Ltda., which will subscribe for and pay in a capital increase at BR Partners Banco de Investimento S.A. (Banco BR Partners), subject to Central Bank of Brazil approval. The intra-group injection is intended to strengthen the bank subsidiary's capital structure and support business development. No price per share, premium, stake change, advisor, or deal timeline was disclosed; no third-party transaction or special situation arises from this routine affiliate capitalization notice.
